component_anchors.text: FY2015–FY2017 reported attributable profit excluding non-recurring items supplies a consistent consolidated ordinary-earnings reference, but the source does not allocate it among business components or separately identify acquisition effects. 因此，This is a conditional reporting-scope reference only; it cannot establish a component-normalized earnings conclusion by itself. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain same-perimeter component revenue, operating profit, and reconciliation of acquisitions/new businesses across the reference years. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利只进入条件范围；普通股现金不适用；不适用；永久损失不适用；估值只作为条件性主要估值输入。晋级检验：Reconcile the reported adjusted attributable-profit series to stable component and acquisition perimeters. 失效检验：Evidence shows that changes in consolidation scope or noncore businesses materially drive the reported reference interval.

Refrigerator/freezer compressors are an explicitly disclosed core product with global refrigerator-company customers, but the package gives no component income, cash, working-capital, capex, or borrowing allocation. 因此，The core can inform the conditional consolidated route but cannot independently create a normal-earnings or owner-cash range. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain refrigerator-compressor component revenue, volume/price, gross-margin, operating-cash, working-capital, and capital-spending disclosures on the same perimeter. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利只进入条件范围；普通股现金尚未形成可承保范围；对融资压力的影响取决于条件；永久损失进入条件性永久损失路径；估值只作为条件性主要估值输入。晋级检验：Same-scope refrigerator-compressor earnings and cash evidence confirms the core is represented by the consolidated reference. 失效检验：Core product price, volume, unit cost, or cash conversion differs materially from the consolidated series.

Commercial compressors are disclosed as a principal product, but the supplied reports provide no component-level revenue, profit, cash, capital, or debt allocation. 因此，No commercial-compressor earnings, owner-cash, or value-route contribution is authorized from the consolidated disclosures. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain commercial-compressor revenue, profitability, cash conversion, capital requirements, and financing allocation on a comparable perimeter. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利尚未形成可承保范围；普通股现金尚未形成可承保范围；尚未形成可承保范围；永久损失尚未形成可承保范围；估值尚未形成可承保范围。晋级检验：Component-level commercial-compressor earnings, cash, capital, and financing data become available on a comparable perimeter. 失效检验：The commercial business is shown to be immaterial or economically outside the reported compressor operating perimeter.

Trade, technical services, automotive air-conditioning compressors, and cleaning robots are disclosed as new or acquired businesses; their current combined revenue/profit share is described as small, but acquisition amounts and component cash/capital allocation are not reconciled to the consolidated series. 因此，Exclude noncore and acquisition optionality from the conditional consolidated earnings route and do not turn purchase consideration into normal operating cash or return on growth capital. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain post-acquisition purchase-price allocation, operating profit, operating cash flow, capital commitments, and attributable financing for each noncore activity. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利排除；普通股现金排除；对融资压力的影响取决于条件；永久损失排除；估值排除。晋级检验：Noncore acquisition-level operating profit, cash conversion, capital employed, commitments, and financing are separately disclosed and comparable. 失效检验：The previously small new-business activities become material to the consolidated reference without a comparable reconciliation.

The consolidated record shows negative FY2017 operating cash flow, inventory growth, higher short-term borrowing, restricted assets, and borrowing cash flows, but none is assigned to a component and customer-collection detail is absent. 因此，Use it as a survival and financing stress path; do not recast group operating cash flow less all long-lived-asset spending as a maintenance-capital owner-cash point estimate. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain component cash conversion, receivable aging, inventory turns, payable terms, restricted-liquidity detail, and debt allocation. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利不适用；普通股现金尚未形成可承保范围；增加融资压力；永久损失进入基准永久损失路径；估值只进入压力情景。晋级检验：Component-level working-capital and debt allocation demonstrates sustainable cash conversion and accessible liquidity. 失效检验：Same-scope data show that the FY2017 operating-cash and borrowing pressure is nonrecurring or unrelated to the continuing operating perimeter.

The reports disclose funded capacity projects and acquisitions, but do not allocate total cash spending, maintenance versus growth capital, commitments, financing balances, or subsequent returns to individual components. 因此，Treat current all-long-lived-asset spending as a capital-allocation and financing-pressure observation only; return on growth capital and maintenance-capital owner cash remain unresolved. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain project-by-project cumulative spend, maintenance/growth classification, commissioning status, incremental operating cash, and financing balance. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利不适用；普通股现金尚未形成可承保范围；对融资压力的影响取决于条件；永久损失进入条件性永久损失路径；估值尚未形成可承保范围。晋级检验：Project and acquisition spending, maintenance classification, financing, and subsequent incremental cash return are disclosed by component. 失效检验：Incremental capital commitments or losses are material but cannot be reconciled to the financing and operating perimeter.

economic_section_anchors.text: 口径：Reported attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items as a conditional reference；Consolidated company and subsidiaries as reported for FY2015–FY2017；截至 2018-12-31；单位 CNY。

economic_section_anchors.text: The reported FY2015–FY2017 adjusted attributable-profit observations form a conditional consolidated reference interval; they are not a component-normalized point estimate.；带符号范围 6.02903e+07–2.03176e+08 CNY；组件权限：只进入条件范围。

economic_section_anchors.heading: 正常盈利组件桥
economic_section_anchors.text: The core product is disclosed, but its share of the consolidated earnings reference and its raw-material exposure cannot be measured from the package.；数值未知：No refrigerator-compressor operating-profit, cash, capital-spending, or working-capital allocation is supplied.；保守处理：Do not adjust the consolidated reference into a refrigerator-core range; retain only conditional route use.；组件权限：只进入条件范围。

economic_section_anchors.anchor_id: 关键敏感性与翻转条件:1
economic_section_anchors.heading: 关键敏感性与翻转条件
economic_section_anchors.text: 驱动：Reported attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items（FY2015–FY2017 reported reference period，单位 CNY）；低 6.02903e+07（FY2017 reported attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items.），基准 1.84969e+08（FY2015 reported attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items.），高 2.03176e+08（FY2016 reported attributable net profit excluding non-recurring items.）。正常盈利传导（权限：只进入条件范围）：影响未知：The supplied series cannot identify a stable component-normalized causal change.；保守处理：Use the reported interval only as the conditional reference and do not translate its dispersion into a standalone normal-earnings adjustment.。普通股现金传导（权限：不适用）：影响未知：No same-scope conversion from reported profit to owner cash is supplied.；保守处理：Do not derive owner-cash sensitivity from the reported profit interval.。价值路线权限：只进入条件性价值路线；不在此生成价值、回报或行动数值。翻转证据：Component-level revenue, price/volume, unit-cost and cash-flow disclosure shows the refrigerator-compressor core does not follow the consolidated reference.；Acquired or new businesses become material enough that the FY2015–FY2017 consolidated reference is no longer comparable.

economic_section_anchors.anchor_id: 关键敏感性与翻转条件:2
economic_section_anchors.heading: 关键敏感性与翻转条件
economic_section_anchors.text: 驱动：Consolidated year-end inventory balance（FY2015–FY2017 reported balance-sheet dates，单位 CNY）；低 7.48246e+08（FY2015 year-end inventory balance.），基准 8.65126e+08（FY2016 year-end inventory balance.），高 1.37885e+09（FY2017 year-end inventory balance; the report attributes the increase to raw-material prices and stock preparation for revenue growth.）。正常盈利传导（权限：不适用）：影响未知：No supported conversion from inventory balance to component-normalized earnings is available.；保守处理：Treat inventory as a financing-pressure signal, not as an earnings adjustment.。普通股现金传导（权限：尚未形成可承保范围）：影响未知：No component cash conversion or maintenance-capital measure is available.；保守处理：Do not quantify owner-cash sensitivity; retain the evidence in the survival and financing stress path.。价值路线权限：只进入压力价值路线；不在此生成价值、回报或行动数值。翻转证据：Subsequent same-scope disclosures show raw-material, inventory or customer absorption pressure reverses rather than persists.；Component cash, capex, working-capital or debt allocation shows that the group financing pressure is not borne by the studied components.
